methodologyNotes: Covers internal solid-state drives (SSDs) for consumer desktops and laptops sold at a published US MSRP or typical retail price. Excludes external/portable SSDs, memory/flash cards, and enterprise/datacenter U.2 or EDSFF drives. Price is typical US retail in USD for the capacity noted in priceNote. capacityOptionsTb lists the offered capacities in terabytes as a comma-separated string (sub-1 TB shown as a decimal, e.g. 0.5). formFactor is the physical form and length enum (e.g. M.2 2280, M.2 2230, 2.5-inch 7mm). interface is the host bus and protocol enum (e.g. PCIe 5.0 x4 NVMe, PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe, SATA III 6Gbps). seqReadMbps and seqWriteMbps are the maximum rated sequential read/write throughput in MB/s (manufacturer spec-sheet figure, typically the best-performing capacity). randomReadKiops and randomWriteKiops are the maximum rated 4KB random read/write performance in thousands of IOPS (KIOPS). nandType is the flash cell type enum (e.g. TLC, QLC, 3D TLC). hasDramCache is true when the drive has an onboard DRAM cache and false when it is DRAM-less (may use host memory buffer). enduranceTbw is the rated write endurance in terabytes written (TBW) for the 1 TB capacity variant; null if 1 TB is not offered (provenance notes the capacity used). warrantyYears is the manufacturer limited warranty in years.

products.name: Samsung 9100 Pro
products.priceNote: Samsung.com official US store lists the 1TB 9100 PRO (MZ-VAP1T0B/AM) bare drive at $339.99 (accessed 2026-07-11); price is for the 1TB capacity. For context, launch MSRP was $199.99 per Tom's Hardware (18 Mar 2025) and street pricing at Newegg was ~$249.99, but the cited priceUsd is the verbatim manufacturer figure.
products.provenance: The official Samsung US product page (source) confirms the exact 1TB SKU MZ-VAP1T0B/AM, lists it at $339.99 for the bare drive, and states headline sequential speeds of 14,800 MB/s read / 13,400 MB/s write with capacities up to 8TB. Tom's Hardware's dated review (18 Mar 2025, corroboration) provides a full verbatim 9100 PRO spec table confirming the model identity (part number MZ-VAP1T0) and: M.2 2280 form factor, PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0 interface, 236-Layer Samsung V8 TLC flash, LPDDR4X DRAM, series-max 2,200K/2,600K random read/write IOPS, 600TB endurance for the 1TB variant, and a 5-year warranty. Per methodology, seqRead/seqWrite and random IOPS use the best-performing-capacity figures (14,800/13,400 and 2,200K/2,600K), each verbatim on both the Samsung page and the review, while enduranceTbw is the 1TB-specific 600TB value.
